title: Quantitative flatness and obstructions in Fourier analysis
summary: Three important problems in Fourier analysis are the Fourier restriction problem, the $L^p$-improving problem, and the Fourier decay problem. Positive results for any of these problems require a quantitative understanding of various geometric properties of the given measure, including curvature and arithmetic resonance.
